tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.title: Get product overview
tools.description: Return an overview of LamportPay: what it does, the demo transfer flow steps, current capabilities, and what is intentionally disabled.

tools.name: list_corridors
tools.title: List payout corridors
tools.description: List the demo payout corridors LamportPay supports, with their demo FX rate against USD, plus supported payout methods and sender currencies.

tools.name: quote_transfer
tools.title: Quote a demo transfer
tools.description: Calculate a demo LamportPay quote: crypto amount in, fees, and the local currency amount the recipient would receive. Uses indicative demo rates; no funds move.

amount.description: Amount of the input token to send.

token.description: Input crypto token symbol, e.g. SOL or USDC.

currency.description: Destination local currency code, e.g. PKR, INR, NGN.

tools.name: explain_fees
tools.title: Explain LamportPay fees
tools.description: Explain how LamportPay's demo fee model works, optionally broken down for a specific USD amount.

usdAmount.description: Optional USD send amount to break the fees down for.

tools.name: get_swap_config
tools.title: Get swap configuration
tools.description: Return the SOL to USDC swap configuration used by LamportPay's Jupiter demo: supported mints, decimals, and the enforced test amount limits.
